title: Solar ROI Calculation Schema
description: Schema for solar ROI calculation inputs

monthly_bill.description: Average monthly electricity bill in MYR

roof_area_sqm.description: Usable roof area in square meters

system_size_kw.description: Desired system size in kW (optional, will be calculated if not provided)

sunlight_hours_per_day.description: Average sunlight hours per day (Malaysia default: 4.5)

electricity_rate_per_kwh.description: Electricity rate per kWh in MYR (default 0.40)

system_cost_per_watt.description: System cost per watt in MYR (default 4.5)

maintenance_cost_percentage.description: Annual maintenance cost as percentage of system cost (default 1%)
